title: .repo-ai.json
description: Config for the @infrazero/repo-ai loop, read by readConfig() in src/base/config.ts.

$schema.description: URL of this schema, for editor completion and validation.

agentUser.description: GitHub login the loop must run as. `loop guard` halts a tick authenticated as anyone else; unset, the loop runs as whoever `gh` is signed in as.

humanUser.description: GitHub login to assign merge-ready PRs, ai-blocked issues and declined issues to. Defaults to the repo owner when it is a user; an organisation-owned repo has no such owner, so set this or those handoffs get no assignee.

requiredSkills.description: Skills `doctor` checks are installed, when agentUser is set. Empty or unset means no check.

pollSeconds.description: Seconds between `loop watch` polls. Each poll costs several GitHub API calls against the 5,000/h limit; values below 60 are raised to 60.

budgetTokens.description: Output-token cap the ai-loop-pickup and ai-loop-recover Workflow scripts enforce per tick, on top of any interactive '+Nk' budget. Once spent, no further agent in that tick is queued — it is skipped, logged, and left for the next tick. Counts output tokens only (the Workflow runtime's budget.spent()); the harness's total, input and cache reads included, runs several times higher.

quietStopMinutes.description: Minutes the loop's status summary may stay unchanged before a tick stops the loop: it deletes its /ai-loop job and stops any `loop watch` Monitor. Typing /ai-loop restarts it. 0 disables the cutoff.

autoMerge.description: Let the loop merge a fully-passed issue PR unattended. Takes effect only when the repo is also release-gated (its publishing job runs behind an environment with required_reviewers). Unset or false, every issue PR stops for a human.

maxInFlight.description: Issues the loop keeps in flight at once (open issues labelled ai-wip); `loop tick` sizes its pickup slots from it. Values below 1 are ignored.

maxFixRounds.description: Fix rounds per PR. ai-loop-pickup runs at most this many, and the round-cap block (ai-blocked) fires on ai-changes application number maxFixRounds + 1. Values below 0 are ignored.

maxTasksPerTick.description: Review and fix tasks the ai-loop-recover Workflow runs per tick; the rest wait for the next tick. Values below 1 are ignored.

staleMinutes.description: Minutes a claim label (ai-wip, ai-reviewing-*, ai-fixing) may sit before `loop reap` treats its agent as dead. Values below 1 are ignored.

busyMinutes.description: Minutes between /ai-loop cron ticks while work is in flight and no `loop watch` Monitor runs. Values below 1 are ignored.

idleMinutes.description: Minutes between /ai-loop cron ticks when idle, and the fallback cadence under a `loop watch` Monitor. Values below 1 are ignored.

dependabotStallMinutes.description: Minutes a `@dependabot recreate` may go without a new head before the PR is handed to the human with a decision comment. Values below 1 are ignored.

maxAgents.description: Agents running at once across every Workflow, counted from claim labels: an open ai-wip issue with no PR yet, each ai-reviewing-* claim, each ai-fixing claim. `loop tick` trims fix rounds, then reviews, then pickup slots so live plus new stays at or under it. Unset means no cap. Values below 1 are ignored.

ciWorkflow.description: File name of the CI workflow under .github/workflows that runs on pushes to the default branch. `loop tick` and `doctor` watch its runs for cancelled-with-no-jobs, stuck-approval and failed-release symptoms; `doctor` warns when the file does not exist. PR checks need no setting — they cover every workflow.
